newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Consmining raises mining sector holdings.
newsitem.headline: Consmining raises mining sector holdings.

text.p: Consolidated Mining Corp Ltd (Consmining) said on Friday it had bought shares in mining house Randgold & Exploration Co Ltd and two gold mines in a bid to enhance its core holdings in the mining sector.
CMC said it had bought 590,000 Randgold shares in exchange for 30 million new Consmining shares issued at 70 cents each with effect from December 10, 1996.
CMC had further acquired 800,000 Randgold shares, 230,000 shares and 175,000 options in Durban Roodepoort Deep Ltd, and 366,000 East Daggafontein Mines Ltd shares.
In exchange for the second transaction Consmining had issued some 72.16 million shares at 65 cents each from February 3, 1997.
